title: Node-editor prior art — the other 26, drawn
summary: The companion to node-editor-prior-art-2026-09-17.html: every idea that report listed as a one-line table row now gets the same visual treatment its 13 featured entries got — one mechanism diagram each, re-verified against real source before drawing.
intro: The first report (file:///home/bam/bbox-ui/reports/media/node-editor-prior-art-2026-09-17.html) drew its 13 featured entries and kept 26 more as dense table rows under “Also surfaced — real, cited, lower priority.” This page draws those 26 — same buckets, same order, same drawn language.

Every figure was re-checked against real source before drawing, in a scratch checkout outside the repo: vyuh_node_flow (MIT), maxGraph (Apache-2.0), litegraph.js (MIT) read and cited by file:line; JointJS (MPL-2.0) read and cited only — nothing copied, the same line held for LGPL libavoid. Each card carries two chips: how the claim was verified, and where this repo stands on it — including one idea a lane is implementing right now and several this tree already half-owns.
One upgrade over the original table: the JointJS Connect-skips-validateMagnet claim, flagged unverified there, is now read directly from both call sites (card 23).
changes: docs/build_prior_art_visuals_fragments.py — generates the 26 mechanism diagrams (inline SVG, the first report's drawn language) plus their verification/status chips and file:line citations.
docs/fragments/prior-art-visuals-{container,layout,runtime,tools}.html — the four bucket fragments this report inlines.
No component, scene, or interaction source was touched — this lane writes docs and the report only.
findings: 26 of 26 drawn; 24 core mechanisms verified in source with file:line; 2 cards carry a sub-claim only documentation supports (card 16's promote-one-field practice, card 19's reverted-to-opt-in history) and say so on the card.

Card 23 upgraded: the original report's one flagged-unverified JointJS claim is now confirmed by reading both call paths — the ordinary press gates on validateMagnet (ElementView.mjs:785) before dragLinkStart; Connect.dragstart calls dragLinkStart directly with no gate.

Already moving here: card 06 (auto-fit reentrancy latch) is the fit-to-content lane's problem right now; cards 03, 09, 12, 13, 14, 16, 20, 24 are half-landed — findCycles, validateConnection, the skin cascade, definitionId, completionMenu (branch), packages/inspector, stock React Flow MiniMap, and port.layout.ts's placement presets respectively.
Card 04's answer is architectural: bbox-ui's core owns no z-index by design, so Vyuh's three-moment invariant lands as a per-host checklist (reparent, drag-start, load), not a core feature.
None of the 26 was judged too thin to draw — the honest count stayed 26.
